spec.requirement: `auger spec list` and `auger spec assemble` select blocks by `--id`, `--kind`, `--applies-to`, `--status` and `--version`, ANDing criteria across flags and ORing repeated values within one flag. An assembly contains the matched blocks plus their explicit closure — forward `depends-on` and inverse `verifies`, so a requirement pulls the criteria and verifications that name it — and `--no-deps` emits the matched set alone.
spec.acceptance: `auger spec assemble <root> --out <file>` with no selector exits 2, prints `spec error (empty-selector)` on stderr, prints nothing on stdout, and creates no file: assembly is never a silent whole-corpus dump.
spec.verification: Assembles one requirement from a two-file fixture corpus and asserts the emitted ids are the requirement, its acceptance criterion and its `depends-on` target, in provenance order, with the edge that pulled each dependency and `refs=`-only blocks never expanded.
Runs `spec assemble` with no selector and an `--out` target, asserting exit 2, empty stdout, the `empty-selector` error class, and that the target was never created.
